[Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky)](https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky) from Poly Haven, [CC0](https://polyhaven.com/license). This fixture uses the 2K Radiance panorama for sky and ambient light.

[Grass Medium 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/grass_medium_01) by Rico Cilliers and Rob Tuytel, [CC0](https://polyhaven.com/license). Two tufts from the dry diffuse and alpha maps share a small cutout texture.

[Qwantani Sunset](https://polyhaven.com/a/qwantani_sunset), photographed by Greg Zaal and processed by Jarod Guest, [CC0](https://polyhaven.com/license). The ridge film uses a downsampled 2560 × 1280 linear panorama.

[Wild Rooibos Bush](https://polyhaven.com/a/wild_rooibos_bush) and [Sand Rocks Small 01](https://polyhaven.com/a/sand_rocks_small_01) from Poly Haven, [CC0](https://polyhaven.com/license). One shrub and one group of stones were simplified from the scans. The models retain the source diffuse maps and the shrub cutout mask.

The wreck smoke and flame fields in `engine-fire.bin` were simulated for this project in Blender. Each record contains one lossless WebP sheet of optical density, flame and sunlight transmission, sampled at 12 frames per second. The earlier ridge cut interpolated adjacent samples. The current film uses the game’s vehicle burner.
